title: 秋の自然のイラスト
subject_en: Autumn nature items, each a separate object, soft watercolour wash look with a visible dark outline, muted warm colours Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 紅葉、どんぐり、きのこ、すすき。やわらかい水彩で描いた、秋の自然モチーフ12点。
items: a chestnut burr half open with a nut inside
a cluster of three brown mushrooms
a bunch of pampas grass stalks
a small pile of mixed fallen leaves
pink cosmos flowers on a stem
two orange persimmons on a branch with leaves
a red dragonfly with spread wings
